transcription: « N° 10 — 27th November 73. On the twenty [seventh] (1) day of November in the year of Our Lord one thousand eight hundred & seventy three, Before me, the undersigned Notary Public, duly commissionned & sworn for that part of Province of Quebec constituting heretofore the Province of Quebec, in the said province, personally came & appeared : [Mr Lawrence Breen, of Wisconsin, Wood County, Wisconsin, in the United States of America, rayé] Mr John Prince, of the parish of St Romuald, Liverpool Division, trader, who did & doth hereby acknowledge & confess to have received previously to the execution of these presents and to his entire satisfaction of and from Mr Thomas Freeley, of the same place, laborer, the sum of twenty seven Dollars current money of Canada with all interest accrued & due thereon to this day, being in full payment and satisfaction of all amounts due to him to this date. […] »
